meta.title: StartupOS: the operating system for building a business
meta.description: StartupOS turns a business idea into an organized workspace: brand, website, marketing, competitor research, pricing, growth and launch planning.
meta.ogDescription: Plan, build and launch your business from one workspace.

budget.reduceScope: Start with a smaller first version, launch in stages, or secure more money before committing.

runway.one: The rest covers about {count} month of conservative-case losses.

what.title: What it is
what.body: A workspace that turns an idea into the first version of everything a new business needs, so you start from a draft instead of a blank page.

capabilities.body: Each business gets its own workspace with these sections.

website.title: Website content
website.body: Copy and structure for several pages, plus titles, meta descriptions and structured data for search engines.

competitors.body: Real competitors and market signals from live web search, with sources. If search is not connected, it says so.
